args.title: Add TSV as a supported report export format
args.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to SUPPORTED_FORMATS and CONTENT_TYPES (e.g. "text/tab-separated-values; charset=utf-8"), and extend toDelimited (or add a delimiter parameter defaulting to comma) so TSV output joins fields with a tab instead of a comma, updating escapeField's NEEDS_QUOTES regex to also treat tab as a delimiter needing quoting. This lets report export offer TSV alongside CSV and XLSX, which the warehouse loader in the issue requires and avoids the manual CSV-to-TSV conversion that breaks on commas in descriptions.
